# GRIN

> > GRIN is a global academic self-publishing platform enabling authors to publish papers, theses, and academic texts with royalty earnings and ISBN distribution.

GRIN operates as an open-access academic publishing platform with over 260,000 papers across multiple languages (German, English, Spanish, French). The platform specializes in helping students and academics publish their work while earning royalties, with support for both traditional and open-access publishing models.

- [GRIN Homepage (Spanish)](https://www.grin.com/es): GRIN Spanish homepage: Buy theses and publish free on platform

## Publishing Imprints & Programs

- [Academic Plus](https://www.grin.com/ueber-grin/academic-plus): Academic Plus imprint for business, media, law, and pedagogy theses

## Publishing Guides

- [Publishing Papers and Theses](https://www.grin.com/hausarbeiten-veroeffentlichen): Guide to publishing papers and theses with 35% royalties
- [New Author Upload Guide](https://www.grin.com/neukunden-upload): Upload guide for new authors publishing academic texts
- [Open Access Publishing with ISBN](https://www.grin.com/open-access-mit-isbn): Guide to Open Access publishing with ISBN on GRIN platform
- [Guaranteed Flat-Fee Payment](https://www.grin.com/garantiertes-einmalhonorar-fuer-ihre-veroeffentlichung): Guide to guaranteed flat-fee payment option for publications

## Legal & Support

- [Publishing Rights & Copyright FAQ](https://www.grin.com/darf-ich-hausarbeiten-veroeffentlichen): FAQ on copyright law and student rights for publishing work
